'''Claudina Rossel Badia'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Rossel|Badia}} (born 12 July 1969) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. She competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1988 Winter Olympics|two events]] at the [[1988 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ro/claudina-rossel-1.html |title=Claudina Rossel |accessdate=24 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418010604/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ro/claudina-rossel-1.html |archive-date=18 April 2020 |quote=Full name: Claudina Rossel Badia}}</ref> She was the first woman to represent Andorra at the Olympics.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/lists/99/manual |title=First female competitors at the Olympics by country |work=Olympedia |access-date=26 June 2020}}</ref>
